column1: # the NPDM declares 32 MB of system resource (virtual address memory) and main never sets a heap: the game maps its memory itself in the alias region.
# nninitStartup asks StandardAllocator for an 8 GB address region, and a static initializer (main+0xca516c) then takes a 2 GB region with
# nn::os::AllocateAddressRegion and memsets it without checking the result: with a 4.375 GB alias region StandardAllocator got 4.06 GB, the 2 GB region
# failed and the memset wrote through null. A 64 GB alias region, as Hogwarts Legacy (address space only, nothing committed)
# the NPDM declares 32 MB of system resource
